title: Rumor Has It: Identifying Misinformation in Microblogs
core_idea: Address rumor detection in microblogs by first retrieving the complete set of tweets discussing a specific rumor and then classifying those tweets using three feature categories—content-based, network-based, and social-psychology—to identify misinformation/disinformation and tweets that endorse the rumor.
tldr: Proposes a two-step approach for detecting rumors in microblogs: (1) retrieve all tweets related to a specific rumor, and (2) use content, network, and social-psychology features to identify misinformation/disinformation and endorsement behavior.
